title: Major CPU-Only Multi-Signal Adaptive Search Architecture
intent: Create a genuinely FayE-specific CPU-only architecture rather than another isolated upstream micro-patch.
sequencing: Run FAYE-0007 as the final planned small isolated MovePicker efficiency experiment.
Perform a non-functional modernization pass on the full engine codebase and CI, preserving algorithmic behavior.
Build FAYE-0008 on top of the modernized validated baseline.

novelty_gate.requirement: Before implementation, audit latest official Stockfish master, historical Stockfish code/PRs, and relevant literature so the core mechanism is not merely a previously used Stockfish feature under a new name.
novelty_gate.current_master_observation: Current Stockfish/FayE NNUE architecture is value-oriented with a single final scalar output; no explicit policy head, uncertainty/confidence head, or unified neural search controller is present in the audited current source.
novelty_gate.reject_if: The proposed core mechanism is already materially implemented in current or historical Stockfish, or if it cannot be isolated enough to test.

modernization.rule: Modernization must be separated from strength changes so attribution remains possible.
goals: sync and reconcile with current upstream-safe infrastructure where appropriate without importing unvalidated strength changes
introduce explicit typed structures for search signals and controller outputs
improve const-correctness, ownership clarity, RAII, compile-time checks, and module boundaries
strengthen CI with compiler matrix, sanitizers, perft/bench determinism, format/lint checks where practical
keep hot-path allocations at zero and preserve vectorized NNUE paths
retain broad CPU portability; do not require GPU/CUDA at runtime
only raise the C++ language standard if compiler/platform matrix proves it safe and worthwhile
acceptance: no material NPS regression before the experimental feature is enabled

core_components.name: Tiny auxiliary NNUE heads
core_components.constraint: Reuse existing NNUE representation; extremely small quantized heads with a strict runtime overhead budget.

core_components.name: Search-instability estimator
core_components.constraint: Use search data already produced by the engine wherever possible.

core_components.name: Tiny learned move-ordering prior
core_components.purpose: Provide a low-cost policy-like prior for move ordering without a large transformer or MCTS policy network.
core_components.constraint: CPU-friendly, sparse/quantized, only if ablations justify overhead.

core_components.name: Unified Adaptive Search Controller
core_components.rule: Controller changes search effort according to explicit uncertainty/complexity/instability rather than one fixed aggressiveness profile.

research_inspiration.title: Amortized Planning with Large-Scale Transformers: A Case Study on Chess
research_inspiration.use: Evidence that policy/action-value knowledge can be distilled from strong search; inspire a much smaller CPU policy prior, not a transformer runtime.

research_inspiration.title: Mastering Chess with a Transformer Model
research_inspiration.use: Domain-specific chess representations can improve efficiency; use only as architectural inspiration for compact relational/search signals.

research_inspiration.title: Evidence of Learned Look-Ahead in a Chess-Playing Neural Network
research_inspiration.use: Motivates policy representations that encode future-move structure; adapt only if a tiny CPU-compatible version can be validated.

staged_validation: A: telemetry-only instrumentation; zero strength behavior change
C: auxiliary-head inference in shadow mode
F: add adaptive null-move/verification and extensions
H: combined controller with full ablation matrix

performance_budget.initial_target_overhead_percent: <=3% NPS for controller/head inference before demonstrated Elo compensation
performance_budget.failure_rule: Any component with significant overhead but no reproducible strength benefit is removed.

progression: independent repeat for promising large changes
ablation tests for every controller component

safeguards: Do not mix modernization-only refactors with strength claims.
Do not replace alpha-beta with MCTS.
Do not require GPU during play.
Do not claim novelty until historical Stockfish and literature audit is complete.
Preserve GPL-3.0 obligations and Stockfish attribution.
